title: Wish it was more sturdy for the price
text: Wish it was more sturdy for the price. I bought this for my son’s Birthday. I did pack it to capacity, but with one hit the string broke and it fell to the ground. Kind of disappointing for the cost. It looked just like the picture and easy to stuff. Wish the string was more sturdy.
